Strategy rules

Strategy: MACD, Heikin-Ashi & Channel Showcase

Enter long on a MACD line/signal cross with a positive histogram and volume

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN macd crosses above signal AND hist is above 0 AND volume is above avg_vol
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price - 2 * atr_value(atr_period)

Enter long on a strong bullish Heikin-Ashi candle inside the channel

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN a strong bullish HA candle (ha_strong_bullish()) AND close is below hi
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price - 2 * atr_value(atr_period)

Exit long on a MACD bearish cross

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN MACD line crosses below signal line (macd_bearish_cross)
THEN close the position

Exit long on a Heikin-Ashi doji

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN an HA doji within threshold (ha_doji())
THEN close the position

Enter short on a MACD line/signal cross down with a negative histogram

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN macd crosses below signal AND hist is below 0 AND close is above lo
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price + 2 * atr_value(atr_period)

Exit short on a MACD bullish cross

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN MACD line crosses above signal line (macd_bullish_cross)
THEN close the position

Exit short on any strong Heikin-Ashi candle

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN a strong HA candle (ha_strong())
THEN close the position
